description: This PHP class MultipartStream implements the StreamInterface to handle streaming multipart/form-data content, constructing the multipart stream with boundaries, headers, and content parts for HTTP POST requests.

classes.name: MultipartStream
classes.description: A class for creating and managing a streaming multipart/form-data content, supporting boundary management, headers, and content parts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MultipartStream with elements and optional boundary, creating the stream.

methods.name: getBoundary
methods.description: Returns the boundary string used in the multipart stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream is writable; always returns false.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for a part based on provided headers array.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates the aggregate stream from elements, adding boundary delimiters.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a single element to the stream, including headers and content.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates headers and stream for a single multipart element, setting default headers if missing.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header value case-insensitively from headers array.
